mapper.select: SELECT LOWER(channel_code) AS channelCode, callback_sign_algorithm AS callbackSignAlgorithm, callback_secret AS callbackSecret, callback_public_key AS callbackPublicKey, callback_notify_url AS callbackNotifyUrl, notify_sign_window_sec AS notifySignWindowSec FROM t_payment_channel_config WHERE LOWER(channel_code) = LOWER(#{channelCode}) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_callback_nonce(channel_code, nonce, biz_type, biz_no, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (LOWER(#{channelCode}), #{nonce}, #{bizType}, #{bizNo}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{expireSeconds}, NOW()), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM t_payment_callback_nonce WHERE channel_code = LOWER(#{channelCode}) AND nonce = #{nonce} AND expires_at <= NOW()
DELETE FROM t_payment_callback_nonce WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id FROM t_payment_callback_nonce WHERE expires_at <= NOW() ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT #{batchSize} ) expired_nonce )
